sentences.text: The current UCB rule says fees or charges not mentioned in the KFS cannot be charged at any stage during the loan term without the borrower’s explicit consent, but its applicability to this case is not established because the sanction date is not provided.
The home loan agreement’s fee table lists a processing fee of ₹400 and a documentation fee of ₹500, while the KFS lists only a processing fee of ₹400.
The earlier 2024 KFS circular is no longer in force as of 2026-11-23.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB rule on fees not mentioned in the KFS and the loan documents, but the sanction date needed to confirm applicability was not provided.
